newsitem.title: USA: Jameson Inns files $100 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: Jameson Inns files $100 million shelf.

text.p: Jameson Inns Inc said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $100 million in common and preferred stock and warrants to purchase common stock.

Proceeds will be used for working capital and for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of indebtedness, the financing of capital commitments and possible future acquisitions associated with the continued expansion of the company's business, Jameson said.
Jameson, of Atlanta, Ga., is a self-administered REIT which develops and owns Inns operating in the southwestern United States.
